grade.basis: Independently inspected allfour complete one-page parts. First violin carries the upper melody, in a compact ordinary stopped register; slow whole/half/quarter notes, simple slurs, isolated accidentals and no double stops, rapid passagework or demanding shifts. Lower parts have straightforward long-note harmony and quarter-note motion. Controlled sustained bowing, intonation and shared phrasing fit early-intermediate level1; no ensemble uplift.
